input.title: fix-slugify-diacritics exploration
input.content:
**What**: slugify('Crème Brûlée') returns 'crème-brûlée'; expected 'creme-brulee'.
**Why**: Root cause in src/slugify.js line 10: regex /[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu treats accented letters as letters and keeps them. No normalization step.
**Where**: src/slugify.js, test/slugify.test.js (3 existing ASCII tests: 'Hello World', '  Rock & Roll!!  ', 'Top 10 Tips'). README line 5 mentions slugify.
**Assumptions (unattended, no user Q&A)**: ASCII output behaviour unchanged; non-Latin scripts (CJK, Cyrillic) remain kept as today (out of scope); no new dependencies; Node>=26 so String.prototype.normalize available.
**Approaches**:
A (recommended). NFD normalize + strip combining marks: .normalize('NFD').replace(/\p{M}+/gu,'') before the non-alnum replace. Low complexity, no deps, ASCII untouched. Con: does not map non-decomposable letters (ß, ø, æ, đ, ł) - they stay as letters.
B. A plus small explicit map for ß->ss, æ->ae, ø->o, đ->d, ł->l, œ->oe. Low-Medium complexity; more complete, but expands scope and requires choosing mappings.
C. Add dependency (slugify / transliteration lib). Handles all scripts, but adds dependency to a tiny lib and may change ASCII behaviour. Not recommended.
**Recommendation**: A; B as optional follow-up.
**Tests to add**: 'Crème Brûlée'->'creme-brulee'; 'Café Münster' ; precomposed vs decomposed input equal; ASCII regression retained.
**Risks**: leftover non-decomposable letters; non-Latin scripts still non-ASCII; lowercase before/after normalize order (do lowercase then normalize is fine).

input.title: fix-slugify-diacritics brainstorm
input.content:
**Problem**: slugify keeps accented Latin letters; should transliterate to ASCII.
**Selected approach**: A (NFD normalize + strip \p{M}), chosen for minimal change and zero deps.
**Scope in**: Latin diacritics decomposable via NFD; regression tests. **Out**: ß/ø/æ/ł mappings, non-Latin scripts, new deps.
**Key decisions**: unattended run, assumptions made without user input; ASCII behaviour must stay identical.
**Open questions**: should ß/ø/æ be transliterated (Approach B)? should non-Latin scripts be dropped or kept?
**Iterations**: 0 refinement rounds (no human available; readiness gate skipped).
